proxy_iface.description: Default interface to proxy on behalf of when no per-interface rule matches

timeout.description: Global neighbor cache timeout in seconds

rules.description: Global proxy behavior rules; each must be one of: 'router', 'host', 'static'

interfaces.description: List of interfaces with per-interface proxy configuration

description.description: Human-readable description of this interface's purpose

rules.description: Proxy behavior rules for this interface; each must be one of: 'router', 'host', 'static', 'autonomous', 'managed', 'other'

timeout.description: Neighbor cache timeout in seconds for this interface

router_priority.description: Router priority (0–255) for Router Advertisement messages. Omit (null) to use default.

router_lifetime.description: Router lifetime (seconds) in Router Advertisement messages. Omit (null) to use default (1800–9000).

static_entries.description: List of static neighbor entries (IPv6 address to MAC mapping)

iface.description: Interface on which this entry should be announced

description.description: Optional human-readable label for this entry
